html:
A state proclaimed by the Polisario Front on 27 February 1976 at Bir Lehlou, the day after the last Spanish troops left Spanish Sahara.

Its government works from the refugee camps near Tindouf in Algeria and controls the thinly peopled land east of the Moroccan wall. Dozens of states have recognised it, mostly in Africa and Latin America, though several have since withdrawn recognition. In 1984 it joined the Organisation of African Unity, and Morocco left the body in protest, returning to its successor, the African Union, only in 2017. Both now sit side by side in it.
sum: A state proclaimed by the Polisario Front on 27 February 1976 at Bir Lehlou, the day after the last Spanish troops left Spanish Sahara.
